lessons.title: What is Regression? 🔢
lessons.description: Learn how supervised learning predicts continuous values through intuitive real‑world analogies.

lessons.title: Simple Linear Regression 📈
lessons.description: The equation of a line, slope, intercept, and how a model fits a straight line to data.

lessons.title: Cost Functions: Measuring Mistakes 💰
lessons.description: MSE, MAE, and why squared errors rule the regression world — plus the danger of outliers.

lessons.title: Gradient Descent: The Learning Engine 🚂
lessons.description: Optimise any model by rolling downhill on the cost surface; learning rate, iterations, and convergence.

lessons.title: Multiple Linear Regression 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
lessons.description: Bring more features to the party, understand matrix notation, and interpret coefficients correctly.

lessons.title: Evaluating Regression Models 🧪
lessons.description: R‑squared, adjusted R‑squared, residual plots, and how to spot overfitting vs underfitting.
